'''Ton Arashai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] secret agent who gained access to the upper echelons of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] society through his employment as a maintenance worker in the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]]. In his unassuming position Arashai was able to obtain vital important information with regards to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] dissent. He believed that [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] was affiliated with a growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|resistance faction]] who opposed the Galactic Empire, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent who believed the same, to prevent the individual from exposing Organa's covert dealings. He believed that the Alderaan native's rebellion movement would sufficiently destabilize the Empire, at which time the Nagai would commence their own invasion into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
